description: Too old to walk to Warwickshire

participation.context: Spoke the yard, withdrew the price, and stopped on the left side.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

relations.note: three years, and no sum he will keep
relations.quote: What's a house worth? Forty pound? A hundred? I don't know.

story.body: You spoke the strap, the stones, and a house you do not know the worth of. You took the forty and the hundred back in the same breath. You marked one basket, and you did not write it down.

title: Took the guess of the house back and marked the friar
